articles.summary: WATSONVILLE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Granite (NYSE: GVA) announced today the appointment of George L. Nash, Jr. to its Board of Directors, effective August 5, 2026.With more than three decades of leadership experience across the global energy, infrastructure, and construction sectors, Mr. Nash brings extensive operational, strategic, and governance expertise to support Granite’s continued growth and long-term value creation.
articles.title: Granite Appoints George L. Nash, Jr. to Board of Directors

articles.summary: WATSONVILLE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Granite (NYSE:GVA) announced today that it has been awarded an approximately $31 million Early Works Grading Package by Hydrostor for its Willow Rock Energy Storage Center (WRESC) Project, located north of Rosamond in Kern County, California. The award will be included in Granite’s third quarter 2026 CAP.
articles.title: Granite Awarded $31 Million Early Works Package for Willow Rock Energy Storage Center in California

articles.summary: Among the most visible additions are a new 12-foot-wide multi-use path stretching more than 7 miles along the corridor, and a pedestrian and bicycle underpass that provides safe access beneath SR-30. Together, these features create new opportunities for cyclists, runners, and outdoor enthusiasts while improving connectivity throughout the area. For motorists, the project is a major safety improvement. What was once a two-lane roadway with no shoulders now includes 12-foot shoulders, turn lanes, a center median, center barrier, and guardrails.
articles.title: Granite Completes SR-30 Improvements

articles.summary: UCON’s Safety Awards Program recognizes excellence in jobsite safety, leadership, and innovation across California’s union construction industry.Safety is more than a priority—it's the foundation of every successful construction project. United Contractors (UCON) announces the recipients of its 2025 R.E.A.L. Safety Awards, honoring the companies, projects, and safety professionals whose leadership continues to raise the standard for jobsite safety across California's union construction industry.
articles.title: United Contractors Announces R.E.A.L. Safety Award Winners

articles.summary: Granite Guam has been recognized with the 2025 Pro Patria Award, one of the highest honors presented by the Employer Support of the Guard and Reserve (ESGR), a program of the U.S. Department of Defense.The award was presented during an ESGR recognition ceremony on August 4, 2026, and accepted by Marjune Padigos, Construction Manager. Granite Guam was nominated by Staff Sergeant Brian Barcinas of the Guam Air National Guard for its exceptional support of employees serving in the National Guard and Reserve.
articles.title: Granite Guam Honored with 2025 Pro Patria Award
